title: trailboss --json checkpoint restore AGENT:ID N [--yes]
description: Putting a session's folder back as checkpoint N, one row per step. Without --yes, the plan: `would write` (from the checkpoint) or `would remove` (the checkpoint doesn't have it) per file. With --yes: a `safety` row whose path is the checkpoint ref holding the folder as it was (restore it to undo), then `written`, `removed` or `failed` per file, and a `kept` row whose path is the undo-stash folder holding every file replaced or removed. `skip` rows: files git ignores, submodules, or a folder already as the checkpoint. File paths are absolute.

action.description: would write, would remove, safety, written, removed, failed, kept or skip
